_comment: Inputs for build.py. Edit only at month rollover (budgets, radio). Spend plan = that month's total budget (channel budgets + Radio + SEO fee). CPA target and GA4 sessions target = rolling average of the last 3 COMPLETE months (CPA pooled = total spend / total orders; sessions = mean of monthly GA4 sessions) unless cpa_target_override / sessions_target_override is set.
